themes.name: Agentic AI
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems designed to autonomously perform tasks, make decisions, and interact with environments, often through multiple interconnected agents.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that aid developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, acting as intelligent programming partners.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses AI tools and platforms specifically designed to support and accelerate various stages of research, from data gathering to analysis and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights a broad range of AI-powered tools used to enhance research processes and deliverables across different domains.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the development, capabilities, and impacts of AI-powered chatbots, including their use in information retrieval, customer service, and therapeutic contexts.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being applied to the design process, including UI/UX design, generative design, and the creation of AI-driven user experiences.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze customer data and generate actionable insights into behavior, preferences, and sentiment.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Discusses the creation and use of synthetic data or virtual representations of users for testing, research, and simulation purposes.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Examines how AI is used to automate and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of testing processes, from software quality assurance to product validation.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Investigates the effects of AI on employment, including job displacement, creation of new roles, and the changing skills required in the workforce.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
